about_short_description.short_description: AbuErdan is a cloud-based poultry management solution that empowers poultry companies

product.name: Integrated Value-chain Management
product.description: A system that integrates all divisions of a poultry company to provide unified management, analytics, and traceability across the entire value chain.

product.name: Artificial Intelligence
product.description: Uses deep learning and predictive analytics to forecast poultry performance and assist in operational planning and supply chain forecasting.

product.name: Broilers Management
product.description: Tracks and analyzes performance metrics for broiler chicken operations to support timely decision-making and operational control.

product.name: Breeders Management
product.description: Monitors detailed operational data for breeders and integrates with hatchery data to provide comprehensive production indicators.

product.name: Hatchery Management
product.description: Collects and correlates hatchery data to connect breeders with broilers or chick sales, tracking production KPIs and generating analysis reports.

product.name: Slaughterhouse Management
product.description: Monitors quality, supply, yield, equipment usage, and supply consumption in slaughterhouse operations to support management control.
